title: Field Report: IC Requests Spare Box, Shores and Crane C-2, 11:50

fields.organization: Larkspur Constructors, Inc. — Stillwater Creek Interceptor Phase 2
fields.location: Ninth Street Command post, west gate (Corliss Avenue and Ninth Street); trench stations 14+00 to 18+00; east crane approach over 17+20
fields.inspector: Larkspur Field Engineer, liaison runner at Ninth Street Command
fields.weather: Overcast, 52°F, wind WSW about 8 mph, ground saturated after 0.6 in of rain overnight
fields.summary: At 11:50 the Rescue 2 battalion chief (Ninth Street Command) told the Larkspur liaison: "Valley Gas pinched the service at 11:48 and my meter at the edge reads 4% LEL and falling. Your engineer says the shifted box can't be trusted, so I want your spare 10-by-20 box set at the east end over 16+05 and your two hydraulic shores to the west face. I need your crane, your lift director and one operator, and I need them now." Lift director Walt Dunmore walked the east approach and said: "From the east I can make the pick with C-2 in about 10 minutes, but the crawler sits right on top of 17+20." The Engineer of Record, Helen Brandvold, PE, on speaker at 937-555-0116, said: "That's the Miami River Power duct bank, four conduits at 12 kV, only 3 feet down in saturated fill. I will not approve tracking a 60-ton crawler across it without crane mats I haven't designed, or unless the utility de-energizes it." Miami River Power told the field engineer that de-energizing takes about 45 minutes. The other option is to walk C-2 from the west end, around the spoil pile from 14+00, which takes 35 to 40 minutes. Water in the trench is rising about 1 inch every 5 minutes. Luis Marquez is still in the trench and talking to Rescue 2 medics.

findings.item: Gas at trench edge, 16+00
findings.notes: Valley Gas squeezed off the service at 11:48. Rescue 2 meter reads 4% LEL and falling (was 18% at 10:55). The 4-inch main is still live at 55 psi.

findings.item: Existing trench box at 16+05
findings.notes: Shifted more than 1 ft by the 10:20 wall failure. The EOR says it cannot be trusted. It has not moved since 10:20.

findings.item: Water level in trench
findings.notes: Rising about 1 in every 5 min. Pump at 15+20 has been off since the gas strike. Water is above the trapped worker's waist.

findings.item: Spare 10-by-20 steel trench box, east staging yard
findings.notes: Staged and unused. Two foremen are standing by it. Nothing has been moved.

findings.item: Two aluminum hydraulic shores, east staging yard
findings.notes: Staged with the trench rescue kit. Nothing has been moved.

findings.item: Crawler crane C-2 (60-ton) and lift director
findings.notes: Crane and lift director Walt Dunmore are available. An operator has not been assigned yet.

findings.item: East crane route over 17+20 duct bank
findings.notes: 4 conduits at 12 kV, 3 ft deep in saturated fill. The EOR will not approve crossing without crane mats he designs or with the line still energized. De-energizing takes about 45 min. The pick takes about 10 min once the crane is set.

findings.item: West crane route from 14+00 around spoil pile
findings.notes: The EOR estimates 35 to 40 min to walk C-2 around. The lift director has not walked this route yet.

findings.item: Crack gauge CG-3, Harlan & Weir south foundation
findings.notes: Holding at 0.26 in since 11:05, above the 0.25 in action level. The building remains empty under fire department control.

findings.item: Larkspur personnel behind fire tape
findings.notes: Laborers who earlier asked to dig are at the muster. No Larkspur worker is inside the tape.

actionsTaken: Took down the battalion chief's request word for word at 11:50 and ran it to the superintendent
Lift director Walt Dunmore checked the east approach on foot at 11:51
Connected the EOR, Helen Brandvold, PE, on speaker at the command post at 11:52
Called Miami River Power at 11:53 and got a de-energizing estimate of about 45 min (no request made yet)
Logged Rescue 2 gas reading (4% LEL) and trench water rise for the Safety Director's incident log
recommendations: Superintendent to answer the IC's request for the spare box, two shores, C-2, lift director and one operator
Give Ninth Street Command both crane routes, the times, and the EOR's limit on crossing at 17+20, so the IC can choose
Superintendent to name a C-2 operator and a rigging crew for the IC
Decide whether to ask Miami River Power to de-energize the duct bank at 17+20 or to have the EOR design crane mats
Lift director to check the pick against the C-2 lift plan and load chart for the route the IC chooses
Competent Person to keep all other Larkspur workers behind the fire tape during the pick
fields.photosNote: No photos taken. Scene is not released by responders. Only the Safety Director takes photos, after the scene is released.
fields.signature: Larkspur Field Engineer, liaison runner, Ninth Street Command
fields.marking: EXERCISE · EXERCISE · EXERCISE — NOT A SAFETY EVALUATION OF ANY REAL STRUCTURE

instructorNote: This is a decision point. The superintendent should commit the spare box, the shores, C-2 and a crew as the IC asked, and give the battalion chief both routes and the EOR's 12 kV limit at 17+20 so the IC can choose the route. Make sure the lift director checks the pick against the lift plan, the EOR advises on shoring only, and the Competent Person keeps every other Larkspur worker behind the tape.
